title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions made by the model. Can you identify which predictions are considered positive for Model C?

title: Identifying Positive Predictions
text: For Model C, a prediction is positive if the predicted probability is greater than or equal to $$0.75$$. How many predictions meet this criterion?

title: True Positives for Model C
text: A true positive occurs when both the true label and the predicted label are $$1$$. For Model C, which predictions are true positives?

title: Calculating Precision
text: Using the formula for precision, calculate the precision for Model C. Remember, precision is true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false positives.
